run_migrate_imports_dry_run: run a dry run of the migrate_imports script on a directory to preview import changes
run_migrate_imports_execute: run the migrate_imports script with --execute to apply import path replacements to .py and .yaml files
run_replace_strings_in_file: run replace_strings_in_file to replace old fairchem import paths with new ones in a single file
refactor_replace_strings_in_file: refactor replace_strings_in_file to support additional file extensions beyond .py and .yaml
review_mapping: review the mapping dictionary to verify old and new fairchem import path replacements are correct
